arStrings.szText: The Battle Pass consists of 1 Standard and 3 Premium Reliquaries. Premium Reliquaries can be purchased with  {icon:CurrencyIcon, 2.0}  {c_highlight}Platinum{/c} individually or as part of a bundle for additional savings or rewards.
The new home of the Battle Pass that lets you choose the order you pursue the rewards. However, Reliquaries are more than just the Battle Pass. Be on the lookout for special Event Reliquaries.

The {c_highlight}Premium Battle Pass Bundle{/c} unlocks all 3 Premium Reliquaries at a discount, while the {c_highlight}Deluxe Battle Pass Bundle{/c} gives instant access to the bonus armor set and 2 additional rewards you won’t find in the other Reliquaries.
Fill up your Favor bar by killing monsters and completing quests. Each time you fill the bar, you’ll earn 1 {icon:ReliquaryFavorIcon, 2.0} {c_highlight}Favor{/c} Token.
You can hold up to 99 Favor Tokens. Once you reach that number, you must spend them before you can earn more. Favor Tokens, up to the cap of 99, will carry over each season.
Use the Favor Tokens you earn to claim rewards in the Battle Pass.
Favor Cap Reached. Max 99. Spend tokens to earn more.
